sentences: Our annualized H1 FY27 credit cost of 3.43% includes normative credit cost of 2.98% and 0.45% of macroprudential buffer, which is well within our guided range.
We raised our profitability guidance for FY27, ROA of 5.2% to 5.8% versus 4% to 4.8% earlier and ROE of 21% to 24% versus 16% to 20% earlier.
We retain our AUM growth guidance of 20% to 25%, supported by return to growth in Group Loan portfolio, coupled with continued momentum in Retail Finance.

We expect a NIM of 14.4% to 14.7% as against 12.8% to 13.2% guided earlier, driven by healthy asset quality, strong control over borrowing costs and a higher capital position even after factoring the 50-bps rate reduction applicable from October onwards.

sentences: We added 2.5 Lakh new borrowers during the quarter, of which 35% were new-to-credit, and we expect this run rate to improve further, adding close to an average of 1 Lakh borrowers per month going forward.

The average PAR 15 accretion rate for Q1 FY27 stood at ~15 bps per month, whereas the credit cost for the quarter stood at INR 212 Crore or 0.72% on a non-annualized basis, comfortably within our guided range.

Our ability to demonstrate quick recovery helped us report strong improvement in our return ratios in Q4 FY26 and further in Q1 FY27, thus helping us to improve our trailing 12-month ROA to 4% and ROE to 16%, both aligned with our guided cross-cycle profitability metrics.
On the balance sheet side, we continue to maintain ample liquidity with cash and cash equivalents of INR 3,536 Crore, amounting to 10.4% of the total assets.

sentences: The AUM grew 14.0% YoY and 11.4% QoQ, in line with the annual growth guidance, despite 7.6% write-offs made in FY26.
While our PPOP was in line with the budget, our credit cost ended at 6.74% as against the guidance of 5.5% to 6.0%.
The additional 0.64% credit cost due to increase in ECL rates resulted in marginal miss on the lower end of our ROA and ROE guidance of 2.9% and 11.8%, respectively.
CA Grameen is steadily evolving to target the vast and underpenetrated opportunity of serving the 23.5 Crore low-to-middle income households by 2030.

sentences: We continue to maintain a healthy new-to-credit ratio of 39%, which is reflected in the increase in the share of unique borrowers to 43.4% in December 2025 from 26.4% in August 2024, positioning us well for quality growth ahead.
Our FY27 credit cost guidance of 4% to 4.5% reflects a new PAR 15 accretion rate of 30-35 bps per month.
It is important to note that the company moved towards this 50% salary levels, including DA and basic to meet this guidance proactively, leading to very little impact during this quarter.
Our foreign borrowings stood healthy at 24.3%, moving closer to the medium-term target of 25-30% by FY28 as we scale our business.
